Production signals

Facts about who made the game and how players received it. They don't depend on AI, and they help tell a carefully made game that used some AI apart from mass-produced ones.

  • Winning Streak Games GmbH released 1 game on Steam in the last 12 months. 2 of their 2 games disclose AI.
  • On Steam since 2024 with 2 games.
  • 223 player reviews, 78% positive (Mostly Positive).
  • Our AI review of these signals: solid production.

What the developer says

In WE ARE FOOTBALL 2027 we use about 12,500 AI-generated realistic-looking photos for generic male and female players. These pictures are e.g. displayed on the line-up screen or on the player profile screens. Only photographs of persons photographed specifically for this purpose were used.

From the “AI Generated Content Disclosure” on the Steam store page, quoted as written. First seen by us on Oct 28, 2026.

Reasoning

The disclosure states AI-generated photos of generic players are shown in-game, so some shipped assets are AI. This is one asset type within a large management simulation with 213 reviews and 80% positive, indicating real development effort. The studio released only one game in the past year, so no volume-release pattern.

Against: The photos are a supporting visual element rather than core content, and the developer says only purpose-shot photographs of people were used as source material.
